notes.title: What's New in Version 2.9.4
notes.content:

[list]
[*] The game will no longer get stuck while Exploring with Scotland 1+ when Mapmakers Chart the Wild is in effect.

notes.title: What's New in Version 2.9.3
notes.content:
This update has a number of improvements and bug fixes, including:
[list]
[*] Spirit Foresight now shows the Setup symbols in lands when you inspect them.
[*] While playing with Diversity of Spirits, Powers that repeat themselves no longer cause the game to stop progressing.
[*] When Resourceful Populace is in effect, Foundations Sink Into Mud no longer gets out of sync in multiplayer when used in a land with Finder of Paths Unseen's Presence.
[*] Pour Down Power Across the Land will now work properly for Powers used during an Event.
[*] Aid From the Spirit Speakers and Paths Tied by Nature can no longer be used to push Presence to an illegal land.
[*] Responsibilities to the Dead will now only trigger once from Melt Earth Into Quicksand.
[*] Spreading Timidity II/III no longer allows you to choose the same land more than once.
[*] While using Pour Down Power Across the Island, you can no longer use both abilities at once if you select the Gain 1 Energy ability while resolving a repeated power.
[*] Open the Ways is now usable between self-repeating powers like Lay Paths They Cannot Help But Walk.
[*] Fixed an issue in Second Wave where Open the Ways could incorrectly apply to all triggered Actions if Finder of Paths Unseen was present in the previous game.
[*] When the first and second thresholds of Lay Paths They Cannot Help But Walk are available, omitting the first threshold and not the second no longer causes the power to target no lands.
[*] Finder of Paths Unseen pushing pieces with Paths Tied by Nature is now able to push into oceans when Ocean’s Hungry Grasp has a presence on that board.
[*] Gift of Furious Might now increases the damage of Foundations Sink Into Mud.
[*] Uncanny Melting now interacts correctly with Scotland 5+ and ocean Blight.
[*] Fixed an issue in which Eager Explorers would not always recognize adjacent lands that are isolated, especially with Open the Ways.
[*] When Sprawl Contained by the Wilds is in effect, Dahan no longer ignore the effects of Rain and Mud Suppress Conflict.
[*] The Kingdom of Scotland's Runoff and Bilgewater effect no longer triggers on more than one Ocean when cascading between Coastal Lands on different boards.
[*] The event Rising Interest in the Island no longer removes the specially placed Coastal Lands card from The Kingdom of Scotland 2+.
[*] Fixed a problem where Foreign Dignitaries Visit could incorrectly boost damage in more than 1 land per board.
[*] If a land under the effect of Weave Together the Fabric of Place is Ravaged and flips the Blight Card, using undo no longer causes it to Ravage again.
[*] Habsburg Level 4 Towns no longer retain their Durability in lands with Blight when Sweden's Heavy Mining takes effect.
[*] Fixed an issue where undoing with Heart of the Wildfire could cause continuous Blight and Minor Power prompts.
[*] Repeating Drawing Towards a Consuming Void no longer ignores To Dream a Thousand Deaths.
[*] Fixed an issue where ravages with Habsburg 6 would not work properly with Isolate in some situations.
[*] To Dream a Thousand Deaths no longer ignores adjacency when resolving Forest of Living Obsidian.
[*] Fixed an issue in Second Wave where Slow and Silent Death could incorrectly apply in all lands if Shroud of Silent Mist was present in the previous game.
[*] If Heart of the Wildfire moves Presence to 2 different lands in The Struggles of Growth event, it will only trigger Blazing Presence in one of the lands.
[*] In Elemental Invocation, the corner element between G3 and G4 is now shown in the correct location.
[*] Fixed a problem where Let's See What Happens activating Swarming Wasps would ignore Isolation.
[*] Spirit Foresight now shows the correct Ravage damage amount for a Strifed City when Curse the Tongues of the Foreigners is in effect.
[*] Fixed an issue when Stone's Unyielding Defiance uncovers a "+1 Card Play" Presence space, the Minor Power would not draw correctly, and the placement could incorrectly be undone.
[/list]

notes.title: What's New in Version 2.8.1
notes.content:

[*] Fixed a situation where stacked invader cards were resolved in the incorrect order.
[*] While Ocean in Play is in effect, and Weave Together the Fabric of Place expires, separating a combined ocean and land, Presence can now move properly to either land.
[*] Fixed a problem where Seek Safety (Level 2) would not allow you to gather a Town into a land with City in some cases.
[*] The Struggles of Growth (Leave Behind option) no longer allows you to move the same Presence twice.
[*] Improved how Invaders Surge Inland works with Isolate so you do not have to enable the adjacency prompt.

notes.title: Version 2.7 Now Available: Let's See What Happens
notes.content:
Ready to mix things up a bit? A Spirit with a knack for stirring up trouble arrives on the scene, and Adversary nations join with one another to challenge you in unpredictable ways. Let's see what happens! The eighth phase of Jagged Earth content is now available with a new Spirit and Play Option.

[h2]Grinning Trickster Stirs Up Trouble[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36927348/427b7199a058ddcc14635c17c5c3d679f635dfe7.jpg[/img]
There are many trickster Spirits, but this one is the most infamous. It wears any form it pleases, but can always be distinguished by its multitude of eyes, though they may be subtle or concealed. It has a driving curiosity to see what will happen when it messes around with things. Of course, this may involve putting Spirits, people, and animals alike into suddenly precarious situations, so the Dahan appreciate its shenanigans best at a healthy distance.

[h2]Combining Two Adversaries[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36927348/ca9d52c66f06428f90149784cd7dd8bc9f4f3bfb.jpg[/img]
Through conquest or marriage, one Adversary nation joins with another, shifting their society and how they approch colonization. You can combine two Adversaries for a hybrid challenge, incorporating aspects of both.

No additional purchase is required; you will gain access to the new content and features with your existing purchase of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2419041/Spirit_Island__Jagged_Earth]Jagged Earth[/url]. You can learn more about the new features and associated rules in the How to Play screen.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2419041/Spirit_Island__Jagged_Earth

[*] Forsake Society to Chase Dreams now correctly interacts with a land affected by Melt Earth Into Quicksand.
[*] Fixed an issue in which Russia's Escalation effect would not resolve correctly when a board has no Beasts tokens, but a Many Minds Move as One sacred site.
[*] The Casualties of Fang and Sting event now allows you to select a board that becomes applicable against Russia 2+ and its protected explorers.

notes.title: Version 2.6 Now Available: Observe the Ever-Changing World
notes.content:
An ancient Spirit has arisen to Observe the Ever-Changing World, and finds a new threat with the arrival of the Invaders. It will face many new challenges with new island forms, such as archipelagos of disconnected lands and extra expanses of unoccupied territory. The seventh phase of Jagged Earth content is now available with a new Spirit and two new Play Options.

[h2]Spirit: Shifting Memory of Ages[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36927348/d2233637a8c88afa39eff7e88c1d13e25f32b284.jpg[/img]
An immensely old Spirit that has ascended to great power countless times over the ages − and then destroyed that power each time, severing huge pieces of itself to become small once again. The Invaders’ arrival has pushed it to grow much more quickly than it usually would, re-learning lessons and powers from its deep past in order to fight more effectively.

[h2]Play Option: Archipelagos[/h2] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36927348/a296db6c3de1d156a82cd5e940c739c754d6abf8.jpg[/img]
Instead of laying the Island Boards out as a single island, you can now create two or more smaller islets. Archipelagos are very good at dividing up what board elements a given player most needs to pay attention to, and can make larger games much easier for players to scan and think about.

[h2]Play Option: Extra Island Board[/h2] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36927348/765da7b9e2607cd6f60bb3a148d7a596c27d0107.jpg[/img]

[h2]Multiplayer Plumbing Improvements[/h2]
We have been working to improve the multiplayer workings of the game to eliminate synchronization issues. Spirit Island has many complex rule interactions, and allowing players to do things simultaneously yet still remain in sync with each other is a challenging and ever-evolving task!

To support this we have updated the networking libraries and reworked the Full Sync feature to be more reliable. Ideally you would never need to use Full Sync, but if you run into a problem, we want to make sure your game can continue.

Remember, if you run into a problem in a multiplayer game, please report it in-game using the Help & Feedback button at the time it occurs (and before trying Undo or Full Sync). It also helps a lot if everyone in the game sends a report, so we can see the situation from all angles. That gives us the best chance to solve the problem sooner!

We are planning to add support for saving multiplayer games to continue later, but that feature is not yet available. Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36927348/30535d6a74f2eebce58c0b580feedb235e90a503.jpg[/img]

[h2]Horizons of Spirit Island includes:[/h2]
[list][*][b]Spirit - Devouring Teeth Lurk Underfoot:[/b] Long ago, the being which would become this Spirit was a small, territorial Spirit of the sand-by-water. It waited patiently for small prey to approach, then frightened them towards its waiting maw; when fresh prey was scarce it would scavenge. Most such Spirits stay tiny, but this one happened to take a bite out of Ember-Eyed Behemoth..
[*][b]Spirit - Eyes Watch From the Trees:[/b] Even after centuries, the Dahan find many things about this Spirit somewhat enigmatic. It warns of danger, helps those lost or injured in the forest, and only works mischief on aggressors and the arrogant. Back in the days of the First Reckoning, its faint whispers were a source of dread, but to current generations they're a familiar and expected part of the island.
[*][b]Spirit - Fathomless Mud of the Swamp:[/b] The Island has many swampy deltas along its coasts. Some are fairly navigatable, while others are mazes of murky water, tangled trees, and land that isn't nearly so solid as it appears. This Spirit is one of these latter sorts, with a penchant for spreading - it likes getting everywhere, slowly turning solid ground into muck and mire.
[*][b]Spirit - Rising Heat of Stone and Sand:[/b] Even after centuries, this Spirit remains a bit unclear on why living things get so unhappy about fatal dessication, but the Dahan make such pleasant patterns across its sands that it's happy to forbear.
[*][b]Spirit - Sun-Bright Whirlwind:[/b] A Spirit of sun-warmed and gusting air. It spins leaves and dust into miniature cyclones, playfully snatches at small unsecured objects, and sometimes - when joyful, or upset, or full of the vigor of nature - howls across the island, bending trees and abrading the landscape with pebbles, twigs, shells, and the occasional bird nest.

notes.title: Version 1.5: Multiplayer is Here!
notes.content:
Online multiplayer is now available, so you can play Spirit Island digital with your friends no matter where they are! Access the new mode from the Main Menu and learn more from the How to Play screen.

Multiplayer is fully cross-platform, so you can play with your friends on iOS and Android devices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36927348/3cb760c3e132bdb7e93fdc5e310d175d6558ae1f.png[/img]

This update also adds fine-grained Spirit Phase undo. Growth and other actions in the Spirit Phase can be undone using the buttons directly on their interfaces. You may undo back to before the Spirit Phase (or to when new information was revealed) using the main undo button. As part of this feature, you can independently undo Spirit Phase actions when playing with multiple Spirits. Also, you may use Presence track abilities (e.g. Reclaim One) at any time during the Spirit Phase.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36927348/31c9d9c5c94acd324f82fc3feda38481a3dfce67.jpg[/img]

To help develop your strategy (and communicate with others in multiplayer), you can now add a marker to any land indicating your plans. Right click or use Spirit Foresight to set a planning marker on a land.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36927348/86009fd5f488e537f17987b7cd51d6c9c3e026d4.png[/img]

The [b]Ward the Shores[/b] and [b]Rituals of the Destroying Flame[/b] scenarios have been updated to use a new button on your Spirit summary panel. Use this button to play a Power card face-down as a Warding Pattern or to add a Flame Marker at the appropriate times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36927348/90a3bc18765cb0f4f80b1a7201cd2350242f6d6a.jpg[/img]

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
We'll be monitoring the status of online multiplayer and look forward to your feedback in order to prioritize improvements. If you have any problems or have a suggestion, use the Help & Feedback button in-game to send us a message.

We are looking forward to the possibility of adapting more Spirit Island content in the future. Stay tuned for news about Jagged Earth and other expansions.

[h2]Planning Markers[/h2]
To help develop your strategy, you can add a marker to any land indicating your plans. Five different markers are available to choose from. This feature is available in both single player and multiplayer modes. To learn more, visit the How to Play screen in-game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36927348/86009fd5f488e537f17987b7cd51d6c9c3e026d4.png[/img]

Quickly set a planning marker on a land by right clicking it, then clicking on a marker. Click a different marker to change it, or the same marker again to remove it. All planning markers are automatically removed at the end of the turn when Time Passes.

notes.title: Spirit Island Version 1.0 Officially Released
notes.content:
Spirit Island has left Early Access, and version 1.0 is now available!

To celebrate the launch, Spirit Island will be on [b]15% discount[/b] through August 5th. After that it will be at its regular price of $24.99 USD.

[h1]Thematic Map[/h1]
Optional thematic maps are now available on the New Game screen. These maps represent the canonical Spirit Island, and prioritize theme more highly than the front “balanced” sides: land types cluster together, wet terrains tend to be on the windward side of mountains, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36927348/b9b59c26f57acde2d0c7aff6ae24785ce9745a06.jpg[/img]

The Thematic Map is intended for experienced players, both because finding terrains at a glance is harder with the more realistic art style, and because some of the changes make the game more difficult: more lands per board, clustered terrains, more starting Invaders, etc.

[h1]Card Library[/h1]
Wondering what all the available Powers are, or what Fear cards might come up in a game? Visit the new Card Library screen to find out. It includes all of the cards in the game - Spirits and their unique Power cards, Major and Minor Power cards, Blight cards, Fear cards, Invader cards, Terror Level cards, Adversaries, and Scenarios. Remember, you can right click any card to view the full size with text and artwork!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36927348/cdf4f416b36d9c10c399a0ffa1e65c6b3744951c.jpg[/img]

[h1]Quick Play Improvements[/h1]
Based on suggestions from players and designer Eric Reuss, we've updated the Quick Play feature with a couple of improvements. On Beginner experience level, it's the same as before - just one click to start a basic difficulty 0 game.

On Intermediate and Advanced experience levels, when you click Quick Play you will have the opportunity to choose a specific number of Spirits (or randomize) and a more granular difficulty range (or the default range for your experience level). All randomization in Quick Play is now done by difficulty range and can include thematic maps as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36927348/e1c9e9b53289cad991fa4dfaa20d536bcdac217a.jpg[/img]

Remember, you can change your experience level at any time from the Options screen.

[h1]Achievements & Statistics[/h1]
We've added 18 regular achievements to the game, along with a hidden achievement for those who attune themselves with the ways of the Island. Happy hunting!

Wins and losses are now tracked for each Spirit, Adversary, and Scenario. We're also keeping track of various other interesting data points. See how your progress in Spirit Island is going over time, and compare with the world! 

[h1]Other Improvements[/h1]
This update includes a few other improvements and fixes:
[list][*]Optimized graphics and code to reduce the size of the game and make it run more smoothly.
[*]You may now view the contents of the Major and Minor Power decks and discard piles at any time.
[*]Improved navigation on the How to Play screen.
[*]Fixed: Using Lightning's Boon on Lightning as the last available power can incorrectly continue on to the Invader phase instead of letting you use more powers.
[*]Fixed: Unplaying a card with negative cost during the Blitz scenario could not cost energy if you had 0 energy.
[*]Fixed: Not auto-passing to the next state in certain situations during Rituals of Terror.
[*]Fixed: Setup for some spirits that must make a decision at the start of game not occurring.
[*]Fixed: Not properly handling use of powers that have changed hands mid-turn.
[*]Fixed: Military Response in the Dahan Insurrection scenario not allowing the player to choose a land for each invader when a choice is necessary.
[*]Fixed: Vengeance of the Dead timing issue when triggered by Ravage.
[*]Fixed: Blitz scenario allowing the player to undo after seeing the initial Explore.
[*]Fixed: Tidal Boon and Mantle of Dread asking for a land choice when there were no viable lands to select.
[/list]
[h1]What's Next[/h1]
Spirit Island is officially released, but that doesn't mean we're going to stop working on it. We'll continue to fix bugs and make other improvements. Specifically we're planning to add more user interface improvements, visual effects, strategic planning features, and more!

We are planning to bring the game to mobile by the end of the year (at minimum to iPad and Android tablets).

Plus, there's still bonus content unlocked by the [url=https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/spirit-island-digital-tabletop-game]Indiegogo project[/url] to come:
[list][*]Promo Spirits: Serpent Slumbering Beneath the Island & Heart of the Wildfire
[*]Adversary-specific Invader appearance
[*]Alternate terrain artwork
[*]Alternate Spirit artwork
[/list]
Promo Spirits will be available as DLC, or included for backers who got the Deluxe Edition. The other features will be included in every copy of the game on Steam.

[h1]The Mysterious Future[/h1]
We've heard your demands, and we're considering several other major items for the future, including the Branch & Claw expansion and online multiplayer. And of course, we're all excited for the Jagged Earth expansion arriving on the tabletop this Fall!

Thanks for all your support during Early Access. This is just the beginning and we look forward to the future of Spirit Island!

notes.title: Early Access Major Update #2
notes.content:
The English invasion is at hand in the second major update of the Early Access period. Read on for all the details!

[h1]The Kingdom of England[/h1]
The final Adversary of the core game is now available! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36927348/c7af78d00873f5b2b386a5a9a00050720ea096e9.jpg[/img]

Here is what the Kingdom of England is all about:
[list][*]Buildings, buildings, and more buildings - England sends so many immigrants that the colonies spill over into unexplored lands. It doesn’t start out fast, but constantly pushes its borders forward. They will push hard to found a capital during Stage II.
[*]England is [b]notably easier[/b] for Spirits good at wrecking Towns (e.g. [i]Lightning’s Swift Strike[/i]).
[*]This Adversary is [b]notably harder[/b] for Spirits which rely on moving/killing Explorers to prevent
Invader Builds (e.g. [i]Shadows Flicker Like Flame[/i]).[/list]

[h1]Spirit Focus[/h1]
With multiple Spirits in one game, there can be a lot going on. So much so that it can be hard to even see the Island!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36927348/9e9d7151a76eda022c25233e09cfee4c13918e30.jpg[/img]

Now with Spirit Focus mode, you can zoom in on what a single Spirit is doing at a time, with the other Spirits still just a click away.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36927348/bddcf584ab0db5e7f6be98ac62db600a6d75c5aa.jpg[/img]

Spirit Focus mode is the default when you are playing a single Spirit, and is always available with any number of Spirits by clicking the +/- buttons in the corners of the screen.

[h1]Nexus of Sound Complete[/h1]
Our in-house maestro Jean-Marc has now created dynamic musical elements for all of the remaining Spirits in the core game: Bringer of Dreams and Nightmares, Ocean's Hungry Grasp, A Spread of Rampant Green, Shadows Flicker Like Flame, and Thunderspeaker. These musical elements will come and go as Spirits take actions in the game.

The music will continue to evolve as we improve the game, but we hope you enjoy the complete musical landscape thus far!

[h1]Other Improvements[/h1]
This update includes a host of other bug fixes and improvements. Here's a list of a few notable ones:

Interactions:[list][*]If you click to hide hints, they will stay hidden until you unhide them.
[*]Highlights on power cards are hidden when dragging a power.
[*]When new elements become available during a power resolution, they can be used for the power's threshold.
[*]You can choose the order of destroying Presence from the Blight card (since it may matter with Ocean).[/list]

Information Display:[list][*]Display of increased health on pieces from effects such as Infinite Vitality or England.
[*]The Adversary level number (if any) is shown in the corner of its icon during the game.[/list]

Bugs Fixed:[list][*]Downward Spiral's effect does not let you select more than one Spirit's presence in the same land.
[*]Repeating Land Thrashes in Furious Pain does not respect the land targeting restrictions of the card.
[*]Current energy displayed can be incorrect when playing/unplaying cards quickly.
[*]Infinite Vitality and Call of the Dahan Ways do not interact correctly.
[*]Undoing a ravage could cause incorrect ravage behavior with Sweden level 5.
[*]Undoing blight cascade could cause incorrect cascading behavior.
[*]Coordinated Assault (Dahan Insurrection) does not trigger Vengeance of the Dead.
[*]Sweden can show an incorrect message about adding extra blight when Infinite Vitality is in effect.
[*]Seek Safety (Terror Level 3) can incorrectly destroy damaged Invaders in certain cases.
[*]Using Undo during the reduced difficulty extra Growth can cause incorrect behavior.
[*]Scapegoats (Terror Level 3) could miss destroying towns incorrectly.
[*]Using Bringer of Dreams and Nightmare's innate power on a Spirit with no elements can cause the game to get stuck.
[*]A town being destroyed by being replaced from a damaged Dahan piece does not correctly trigger Vengeance of the Dead.
[*]Blazing Renewal cannot add presence to an ocean when it should be allowed to.
[*]Dahan pushed into and out of an ocean with Infinite Vitality effect could be incorrectly drowned.
[*]Vengeance of the Dead does not trigger correctly when Dahan are drowned.
[*]Try Again does not use Power Progression for a Spirit if you gained all the cards from their Progression Deck.
[/list]

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
The last content item we're working on for the Early Access period is the thematic map. Plus, stay tuned for additional big features like a card library screen, Steam achievements, and statistics. See the store page description for the full list of major items.

When sending in feedback, please take a look first at our [url=https://trello.com/b/Sw2jJ1z4/spirit-island-early-access]status Trello board[/url] to see if it's already on the list. For gameplay issues, check the [url=https://querki.net/u/darker/spirit-island-faq/#!spirit-island-faq]official FAQ[/url] to make sure it's really a bug, and not a misunderstanding.

Thanks for playing and keep sending in your feedback!

notes.title: Spirit Island is now Available!
notes.content:
Spirit Island is now available in Steam Early Access - [b]and it's 15% off for launch week![/b]

The first Early Access release allows you to play full games with 1-4 Spirits. Most of the content of the core game of Spirit Island is implemented and playable: all Spirits, Power cards, Scenarios, and 2 Adversaries.

Spirit Island is under active development and will be updated regularly. You can think of Early Access as a step between Beta and Retail release. There will be bugs, and some content is currently not available, but the game is much further along than what you might see in a Public Beta (See [url=https://store.steampowered.com/earlyaccessfaq/]Steam's Early Access FAQ[/url] for more).

New to Spirit Island? Why not watch an instructional video to learn now to play!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=d2q9ZThCqrQ

Over the next several months, we will continue to add features and content to the game ahead of its official retail launch later this year. Still to come:
[list]
[*] Interactive tutorial
[*] More animations and visual effects
[*] Extended music and sound effects
[*] Card library screen
[*] England adversary
[*] Thematic island boards
[*] Steam Achievements
[/list]
One of the most important aspects of Early Access is hearing from you, the players. You can send feedback (suggestions or bug reports) directly in-game. We will directly respond to players who send feedback, and take all feedback into consideration during development. We have a public Trello board where you can keep tabs on our development progress, and we welcome discussions on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1236720/discussions/]Steam community forum[/url] & our [url=http://discord.gg/handelabra]Discord[/url].
